expanded_element.title: The White temple is surely worth visiting - Review of Wat Rong Khun ...
expanded_element.description: The White temple is surely worth visiting. It is an amazing sight... and one that you should not miss if you have an opportunity. On the downside, unlike many of the other Temples we visited in Thailand, this one frankly does not have the vibes of a temple.. It seems more like a artistic tourist attraction...

items.title: What is the significance of the White Temple?

expanded_element.title: Wat Rong Khun: Chiang Rai's White Temple - Go To Thailand
expanded_element.description: For a moment they look at you intently but decide to give you access to heaven's gate. You cross and… you're in heaven. The White Temple aims to depict the path to heaven, which, according to Buddhist teachings, is only accessible if you focus on the mind and refrain from worldly temptations, desires, and greed.

items.title: Can you wear shorts to White Temple Chiang Rai?

expanded_element.title: Visiting Temples in Thailand - Dos and Don'ts
expanded_element.description: Women are not allowed to wear shorts in Thai temples. A skirt is allowed if it is knee length or longer and of modest style. Shirts must cover the chest and shoulders, so spaghetti straps and tank tops are not allowed.
